summary: This code defines a Mongoose schema and model for events, including fields for organizer name, title, description, date, location, ongoing status, faculty name, image, and registered students.
evidence: The use of `mongoose.Schema` to define the structure of the events collection, including fields like `organiserName`, `title`, `description`, `date`, `location`, `is_ongoing`, `facultyName`, `image`, and `registeredStudents`.
The creation of a Mongoose model named `Event` based on the `EventSchema`.
